doc.title: Genevieve Rose interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998

chapter: Listening, recording and being a woman bassist
title: Hand injury and the guitar
summary: She has put guitar aside while a nerve problem in her hand heals.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Right. Are you keeping up your guitar these days?

Well I’m planning on getting back with it a little more. I had the hand injury and so I’m just trying to do the bass right now until the hand totally heals. It’s a nerve problem you know, if it got pushed down on the string I’d get a really sharp pain. So basically I’m just doing the minimal amount of playing on the bass that I can, and no extra instruments, just the bass.
